versions.subject: Merge PR #4939 from @frack113 - Winscp rule from Akira Ransomware report
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\WinSCP.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'winscp.exe'
selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|windash: '-command'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'open '
        - 'ftp://' # cover ftp and sftp
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\WinSCP.exe" OR OriginalFileName="winscp.exe" CommandLine="*-command*" OR CommandLine="*/command*" OR CommandLine="*–command*" OR CommandLine="*—command*" OR CommandLine="*―command*" CommandLine="*open *" CommandLine="*ftp://*"
